identity_basis: The SI synthesis identifies the 1-ethyl-2,3,3-trimethylindolium-derived product and reports HRMS for C24H29N2+; the main paper identifies its 4-(dimethylamino)phenyl donor, conjugated linker and indole acceptor.

solvent.name: glycerol
solvent.model_boundary: implicit continuum solvent; the implementation may use a validated glycerol dielectric model

conformer_coordinate.name: donor_acceptor_torsion
conformer_coordinate.definition: dihedral between the mean plane of the 4-(dimethylamino)phenyl donor ring and the mean plane of the indole acceptor ring; report signed angle convention and actual optimized value

experimental_endpoint.status: public measurement boundary, not a computed target
